title.narrative: Enabling activities to review and update the national implementation plan for the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants (POPs)

description.narrative: The project aims to review and update the National Implementation Plan (NIP), which will be submitted to the government for approval and eventual transmission by the government to the Conference of Parties (COP) of the Stockholm Convention. Participating stakeholders will be able to manage the additional POPs with newly developed technical skills, expertise and awareness.
